tasks.label: Debug: build and start IIS Express
build
args: $installationPath = & "${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe" -latest -requires Microsoft.Component.MSBuild -products * -property installationPath; & "$installationPath\MSBuild\Current\Bin\MSBuild.exe" "${workspaceFolder}\WorkflowManagment.sln" /t:Build /p:Configuration=Debug /v:minimal; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }

tasks.label: restore-packages
args: $installationPath = & "${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe" -latest -requires Microsoft.Component.MSBuild -products * -property installationPath; & "$installationPath\MSBuild\Current\Bin\MSBuild.exe" "${workspaceFolder}\WorkflowManagment.sln" /t:Restore /p:Configuration=Debug /v:minimal; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
